Definition: a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. warfare)
BiblicalUsage: War is the word for battle, and Scripture never treats it as an ordinary human quarrel. The song at the sea calls the LORD a man of war, the law of Deuteronomy tells Israel how to go out to battle, and Ecclesiastes sets a time for war beside a time for peace. David says God taught his hands to war, and his fingers to fight, and Isaiah promises a day when the nations shall learn war no more.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe war is real because evil is real, and God does not pretend otherwise. He fights for His people, He judges nations by it, and He promises a day when swords are beaten into ploughshares and war is learned no more.
